I've looped Ben (capacity/planning) and Marissa (CS/onboarding) to validate the timelines and acceptance criteria. Attached: VoltHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx and summary SOC2 page.

Lauren / Priyom — quick internal note to align on capacity assumptions from the draft MAP before the handshake: 

- Baseline perf assumptions used to size pool: 25 reqs/s at 512 tokens avg => ~2k tokens/s sustained. Using our continuous batching model, that maps to roughly 32x 80GB A100-equivalent GPUs for production with headroom for spikes.
- Alternate quantized profile: user can save ~2.5x on GPU count by moving to 4-bit quantized weights + aggressive batching (estimate: 12–14 80GB-equivalent slots). We should present both so VoltHealth can see cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Lead times: for Dedicated we can commit to an initial tranche in 6 weeks from signed SOW (hardware pooled in our cloud). For Private (customer VPC or on-prem package) plan 8–12 weeks given networking approvals and any HSM/KMS procurement.

Priyom — can you draft the MAP table rows for the two SKU profiles (80GB baseline / quantized alt) and a column for "earliest start date if signed by 9/30"?

Hi Mira and team — attaching the updated MAP table (embedded below and in the Drive link) with explicit milestones and gating criteria. High level:

- Milestone 1 — Staging canary (Acceptance testing): 4x 80GB-equivalent GPUs, acceptance tests (functional correctness, latency under 95th perc) — 2 week window.
- Milestone 2 — Pilot tranche (Load & regression): 12x 80GB-equivalent GPUs (or 5x quantized configuration); run 3-day soak with real traffic replay.
- Milestone 3 — Production rollout: up to 32x 80GB-equivalent GPUs initially, ramp to 48x by month 2 if traffic growth matches forecast.

Procurement & lead-time table (if signed by 2026-09-30):
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed): initial tranche start = 2026-11-11 (approx. 6 weeks after signed SOW)
- Private (VPC package): earliest start = 2026-11-25 (approx. 8 weeks)
- On-prem deployment: dependent on customer hardware procurement; typical window 10–12 weeks from PO receipt.

Acceptance gating: sign-off by VoltHealth ML lead + Redwood CS engineer; two-week rollback window and automatic fallback policy to smaller model variant if latency or cost SLOs are missed.

Attachments included: VoltHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx, hw-requirements-80gb-A100.pdf, SOC2-summary-Redwood.pdf
